protocol.image_view: full original image only; no privileged crops

scoring_protocol.extraction: final content after last </think>; last complete answer tag, else last balanced boxed, else whole short answer
scoring_protocol.mcq: one option letter only; never scan prose or thought for letters; preserve duplicate source labels
scoring_protocol.numeric: whole numeric expression only, exact rational equality; no substring, tolerance, or external judge
scoring_protocol.hrbench: mean of per-cycle row accuracy; category breakdown averaged across its cycles
scoring_protocol.other_benchmarks: row micro accuracy; original metadata groups retained
scoring_protocol.completeness: full dataset accuracy only with all expected rows, zero API errors, compatible run, and no incomplete JSONL tail
scoring_protocol.duplicate_predictions: last complete JSONL record for each ID wins, including a later error
scoring_protocol.known_invalid_annotation: Eleven exactly identified upstream label anomalies (one Zoom, two MME EN, eight MME CN) retain original questions, option labels and gold in primary accuracy; a separately labelled sensitivity excludes them. No label correction or row removal.
